decisions.decision: Root cause of F1 true-removal failure = embedded Adobe Illustrator private editing data (page /PieceInfo -> %!PS-Adobe PGF streams). PyMuPDF redaction only edits page /Contents, never the PieceInfo copy; Illustrator reads its private data and recovers the mark.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed via xref inspection + proven fix + user Illustrator confirmation.

decisions.decision: Fix = strip /PieceInfo (page+catalog) then save(garbage=4,deflate,clean) in pdf_engine.py save step (AGPL seam). Hand-verified 626KB->188KB, %!PS-Adobe streams 0, content unchanged; user-confirmed unrecoverable in Illustrator. Landed as d594335.
decisions.rationale: Minimum-change; closes the threat; content-neutral no-op for non-Illustrator PDFs.

decisions.decision: Prior _deep_check.py / MuPDF / PDFium PASS verdicts on F1-F4 are VOID for certifying true removal — they share the blind spot. Verification must add a PieceInfo/AI-stream check, but Illustrator remains the authoritative gate.
